scope: incremental backend update, persistence, lifecycle, HTTP/file and MCP

checks: model source update -> same-port automatic replacement, continued edits save latest snapshot, same page and undo preserved
real undo/redo and Ctrl+S survive replacement
incomplete/broken code never stops old service or writes the file; pending edit retries after correction
external revision during replacement is never overwritten; current unsaved edit and conflict remain visible
desktop owns replacement lineage and closes updated server

limits: synthetic busy-task injection; no real long Blender render
no download or automatic installation of remote software
new frontend progress UI loads on a normal future page load; existing page has write-time fallback without forced reload
extraCases: same page cannot retarget another root on the same port
format-rule-only upgrade preserves recorded file revision
stopped owner prevents a late replacement after desktop exit
